{{Top|leg}}
A '''neural scrambler''' was a type of device that could wipe a person's memory permanently. The [[Shroud]] used one implanted in the head of his lieutenant [[Evie Bo]] after she betrayed him; after activated with a code word, the scrambler erased Bo's memories entirely.
